journey.name: Run a routine
journey.description: A user starts a built-in routine, pauses and resumes it, skips through every step, and reaches the summary.

actions.action: Verify the player shows "Step 1 of 4" and a running timer
Verify the player shows "Paused" and a "Resume" button
Verify the "Pause" button is shown again
Tap the button that ends the last step
Verify a summary screen for "Morning start" is shown
Verify the Routines screen is shown
